review.tagline: Cross-platform on-device ML pipelines and ready-made vision, text and audio tasks
review.summary: MediaPipe is Google's C++ framework for building on-device ML pipelines from packets, graphs and calculators. It also ships MediaPipe Solutions: Tasks APIs with pre-trained models for vision, text and audio, Model Maker for customizing models with your data, and MediaPipe Studio for browser-based evaluation. Targets are Android, iOS, web, desktop, edge devices and IoT.
review.audience: Mobile, web and edge developers adding on-device vision, audio or text ML
strengths: Tasks APIs cover vision, text and audio with pre-trained models, targeting Android, iOS, web and Python
Input data is processed on device and not sent to Google servers
Model Maker customizes models on your data; Studio benchmarks them in the browser
Low-level Framework lets you build custom C++ graphs from calculators
weaknesses: Tasks APIs send performance and usage metrics to Google; app developers must obtain user consent
Several legacy solutions are no longer supported; code is kept as-is
README marks MediaPipe Solutions as a preview, early release
Primary docs live on a separate Google site; the README is mostly links
needs: Models: MediaPipe pre-trained task models, custom models via Model Maker
